comments.author: Codex
comments.text: The zeros require reinterpretation. All 60,916 Driver rows with idrecolha record zero, and 60,417 have a preceding reading for the same container within 15 minutes; 59,507 of those preceding readings are nonzero. A substantial share of zeros are therefore post-emptying confirmations rather than containers found empty. Any statistic on fill at collection must use the pre-emptying reading of each pair. Please quantify paired and standalone zeros and revise this sentence and Table 4 accordingly.

comments.author: Codex
comments.text: The field inspection of 1 October 2025 offers a direct explanation that is not tested here: containers occur in three-fraction clusters and typically only one unit per cluster is instrumented, with priority to the faster-filling packaging stream. The observed 173 paper, 169 packaging, and 2 glass split is consistent with that policy. Please test the cluster-level selection pattern and the CSV row ordering before attributing the imbalance to truncation.

comments.author: Codex
comments.text: Please verify and document the run-level interpretation with distributions of distance, weight, and containers serviced per idrecolha, and state where weighing occurs. This is necessary before allocating run weight to containers and before comparing the raw fields with the much larger aggregate distance figures reported elsewhere.

comments.author: Codex
comments.text: The nominal coverage period is not necessarily the effective analysis period. Sensor negatives are strongly time-dependent and 2024 contains only four months. Please report an effective analysis window for each source and avoid annual comparisons that treat partial 2024 as a complete year.

comments.author: Codex
comments.text: This statement is incorrect: start and end timestamps are populated on 60,916 Driver rows, while Rota is populated on only 22,674 rows; 38,242 timestamped rows have no route code. Please correct the relationship and report the distributions of start hour, day of week, and run duration because these fields provide direct evidence for routing shift constraints.

comments.author: Codex
comments.text: Please test the stream-specific route interpretation directly. In the raw data, 91 of 92 coded routes contain one waste fraction; the remaining route or malformed prefix should be identified and explained. This matters because allocating trip weight is less problematic within a single bulk-density stream than across mixed fractions.

comments.author: Codex
comments.text: The section assesses fitness by variable but not the sample used by the existing regression. This report establishes populations of 816, 464, and 344 containers, while R1-01 reports N = 452. Please identify exactly what the 452 observations represent and document their selection and exclusion rules.
